target_vertical: Maker / handmade DTC small manufacturers (Etsy-vertical leader)
pricing_model: Tiered subscription based on monthly order-line volume (5 plans: Pro, Studio, Indie, Business, Growth)
free_trial_or_freemium: 14-day free trial, no credit card required
shopify_plus_partner_status: No (not listed as Shopify Plus Certified App Partner)
shopify_sync_direction: Bi-directional: orders/products pulled from Shopify; finished-goods stock levels pushed back to Shopify (manual approval or automatic)
shopify_synced_entities: Products, variants, inventory (stock levels), orders, fees, refunds, shipping costs; can push updated stock quantities to Shopify
shopify_multi_store_support: Multiple sales channels can be connected to a single Craftybase account; multi-Shopify-store specifics [uncertain]
shopify_pos_support: [uncertain] (Square POS supported; Shopify POS-specific behavior not clearly documented)
shopify_metafield_to_erp_field_mapping: [uncertain] — no public documentation of metafield mapping
shopify_variant_option_mapping: Variant-level mapping supported; Shopify variants mapped to Craftybase variations with combinations of option properties
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Scheduled daily pulls (default ~5am local time on lower plans); Business plan adds hourly sync; stock-push can be automatic on stock change or manual approval
shopify_known_limitations: Historical data not always picked up accurately on initial import (community report); no metafield mapping documented; sync frequency capped at hourly on Business plan; no documented support for Shopify Markets / Shopify B2B catalogs
etsy_listing_creation_vs_sync_only: Sync only — imports existing listings, does not create new Etsy listings from Craftybase
etsy_inventory_sync: Per-variation inventory sync; Stock Push to Etsy with manual-approval or automatic mode; pushes triggered when inventory changes in Craftybase (manufactures, adjustments, orders)
etsy_order_import: Scheduled daily automatic pull at ~5am local timezone; manual pull available; hourly pulls on Business plan and above
etsy_synced_entities: Listings, variations (with property mapping), inventory/stock, orders, fees, refunds, shipping costs, receipts
etsy_known_limitations: Daily pull on lower tiers (not real-time); no listing creation from Craftybase; personalization handling [uncertain]; digital products handling [uncertain]; historical import quirks reported
amazon_seller_types: FBA and FBM (Seller Central); Amazon Handmade supported; Vendor Central [uncertain]
amazon_synced_entities: Orders, listings (sync), inventory consumption tracked via BoMs/recipes; fees and refunds imported
amazon_listing_creation: Sync only — does not create Amazon listings
amazon_buy_shipping: No (no in-app Amazon Buy Shipping label purchase)
amazon_fba_inbound_workflow: [uncertain] — no documented FBA inbound shipment creation workflow; Craftybase tracks FBA orders inbound to a nominated location but does not appear to drive Amazon inbound shipment creation
amazon_settlement_report_handling: [uncertain] — Craftybase imports fees and refunds at order level; settlement report posting to accounting not documented (tax amounts explicitly not pushed to QuickBooks)
amazon_marketplace_facilitator_tax_handl: Tax amounts are not currently included in pushes to QuickBooks (explicitly noted in QB sync docs); marketplace facilitator tax handling beyond that [uncertain]
amazon_known_limitations: US marketplace only; no repricing; no Buy Shipping; no listing creation; tax amounts excluded from accounting sync; only available on Business plan and above
xero_supported: None (no native Xero integration as of 2026-05; users manually export Craftybase COGS / inventory valuation reports into Xero). Craftybase has stated they are working on a Xero integration.
xero_app_store_certified: Not listed on Xero App Store
xero_cogs_journal_method: Not applicable (manual entry by user from Craftybase COGS / Inventory Valuation reports)
xero_known_limitations: No native integration; entirely manual workflow
qb_desktop_supported: [uncertain] — no documentation of native QuickBooks Desktop support
qb_app_certified: Listed on Intuit QuickBooks App Store [uncertain on certification badges]
qb_synced_entities: Purchase Orders (all plans), COGS journal entries (Growth plan), Inventory Valuation journal entries (Growth plan); inventory loss/adjustment journal entries; chart-of-accounts mapping for Inventory Asset, COGS, and Losses accounts
qb_accounting_sync_mode: summary_journal — periodic journal entries for COGS and inventory valuation (monthly/quarterly, run on-demand by user). PO export is per-PO. No invoice-per-order sync.
qb_cogs_journal_method: periodic_journal — weighted-average COGS calculated in Craftybase and pushed as a journal entry mapped to the chart of accounts; landed-cost inclusive (purchase shipping/discounts proportioned into material costs)
qb_class_location_mapping: [uncertain] — no public documentation of QBO Class / Location dimension mapping
qb_known_limitations: Tax amounts are NOT included in the push to QuickBooks; COGS sync requires Growth plan ($349/mo or $291/mo annual); summary journal only (no invoice-per-order); user must manually trigger the sync (one-click, not continuous)
other_ecom_channels: WooCommerce (native), Square / Square POS (native), Faire (native), Wix (native), Squarespace (native), PayPal (native); BigCommerce NOT supported; eBay, Walmart, TikTok Shop not supported natively
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: Yes — recipes / BoMs decompose into components; when products sell, raw-material stock is decremented per BoM; multi-level BoMs supported
other_accounting_integrations: None native beyond QuickBooks Online; Xero planned/in-progress; Sage / MYOB / Zoho Books / FreshBooks / NetSuite / Wave not supported
bom_support: Yes — core feature (called recipes / Bill of Materials)
multi_level_bom: Yes — multi-level / nested BoMs supported with unlimited layers
production_orders: Yes — manufacture batch records (production runs) with material consumption; routings/operations are not the focus (lightweight vs full MRP)
batch_lot_tracking: Yes — lot tracking with expiry dates, full traceability from purchased lots to outbound orders
serial_tracking: Yes — batch codes / unique identifiers per finished unit; serial-number style tracking via batch/lot system
bin_location_support: Yes — three-part bin location codes (aisle/row, shelf, position) e.g. A-3-2
multi_warehouse: Yes — multiple stock locations supported (Studio+ plans); workshop, storage, home, etc.
barcoding: Built-in QR code generation; supports smartphone camera QR scanning and Bluetooth barcode scanners; barcode labels can be printed
purchase_orders: Yes — PO creation, receiving, supplier price tracking; proportional cost distribution for shipping/discounts; PO export to QuickBooks on all plans
supplier_management: Yes — supplier records with material-supplier mapping, purchase history, supplier-sourced lot tracking; lead times / MOQs [uncertain]
landed_cost_support: Yes — automatic proportional allocation of shipping, discounts, taxes, and tariffs across line items; landed cost included in material unit cost and COGS
multi_currency_inventory_valuation: [uncertain] — valuation appears to be held in single base currency
ai_demand_forecasting: Demand forecasting feature advertised; whether it uses ML/AI specifically is [uncertain]
ai_purchase_order_suggestions: Replenishment / restock alerts based on consumption and lead times; AI-specific generation [uncertain]
public_api: No public API as of 2026-05; Craftybase explicitly states no API but invites users to inquire about access
integration_architecture: Native (direct integrations built by Craftybase to each platform); no iPaaS dependency
zapier_make_support: No native Zapier / Make / n8n connectors (no public API)
mobile_app: Mobile-friendly web interface (responsive); no documented dedicated native iOS/Android app
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: Mobile web interface supports phone-camera QR scanning and paired Bluetooth scanners; no standalone native scanner app
sync_frequency: Default: daily scheduled pull (~5am local); Business plan and above: hourly sync; manual pulls available anytime; outbound stock push: automatic-on-change or manual approval; QuickBooks COGS sync: on-demand (manual one-click)
shipping_carrier_integrations: None native — Craftybase imports shipping costs from sales channels but does not directly integrate with carriers (USPS/UPS/FedEx/DHL etc.)
three_pl_integrations: Amazon FBA (via Amazon integration); no documented direct ShipBob / ShipHero / Extensiv integrations
g2_rating: [uncertain] — G2 profile exists but star rating / review volume not clearly published in search summaries
capterra_rating: 4.6 / 5 with ~230 reviews (some sources also cite 4.7 / 161 reviews — figures vary slightly by source/date)
notable_customers: Small-batch DTC makers — soap/candle, jewelry, skincare, food brands; specific named customers [uncertain]
last_major_release: December 2025 — QuickBooks Online COGS and Inventory Valuation Sync launched on Growth plan (journal entries mapped to chart of accounts with weighted-average COGS, inventory asset, and losses accounts)
owner_parent_company: Independent (privately held, founded 2011 by Nicole Pascoe and Nathan Hawes; Pascoe Software / Craftybase)
last_funding_event: Bootstrapped — no publicly disclosed funding rounds [uncertain on any private events]
public_status_page_uptime: [uncertain] — no widely advertised public status page URL
